decisions.reason: Ending the project and discontinuing the review protocol does not modify or invalidate the established Hero V and É accent alignment rule.
The source ends further revisions but does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish, champagne-gold distribution, or other material-treatment attributes.
The source ends future design revisions but does not change the acceptable formats for any proof or artwork files that are delivered.
The project termination does not alter the established common-baseline rule, and the source contains no instruction changing that geometry.
